Thanks for putting this together — a lot of it matches what I picture. Browsing my saved links with their titles, tags, and notes, searching them, filtering by tag, sorting, editing, opening, and deleting all sound right. But reading through your list of what's left out, several of those are things I really do want, so I can't approve it as-is yet.

A few things I'd like changed or added:

- **The app should fill in the details for me.** When I paste in a link, I don't want to type the title and description myself every time — I'd expect the app to go grab the page's title, its description, its little icon, and ideally a preview image automatically. I can then tweak any of that before or after saving if it got it wrong. You've got this listed as excluded, and that's actually one of the parts I care about most.

- **"Read it later" is missing entirely.** A big reason I save links is to come back and read them. I'd want to mark a link as unread/to-read, and be able to look at just my unread ones in their own place, then mark them read once I'm done so they drop off that list.

- **Archiving, separate from deleting.** Deleting for good is fine when I really mean it, but I'd also want to "put away" a link — hide it from my normal list and searches but keep it around in case I want it later. That's different from deletion, and I'd want a separate place to see the archived ones. Right now archiving is excluded and I'd like it back in.

- **Smarter searching.** Beyond plain text matching, I'd expect to search by tag with something like `#tagname`, to combine conditions (this AND that, one OR another, exclude something), and to search an exact phrase by putting it in quotes.

- **Doing things to several links at once.** When I'm tidying up, I'd want to select a bunch of links and, in one go, tag them, mark them read/unread, archive them, or delete them.

A couple of smaller things I'd also want eventually, though I'll let you tell me the right order: writing a longer formatted note on a link and having it show nicely when I view it; saving a search-plus-tag combination so I can reuse it later; bringing bookmarks in from a browser file and sending mine back out; and a few display preferences like default sort order and text size.

Could you revise the spec to bring these in — especially the automatic details, read-later, archiving, and the smarter search? Then I'll take another look.
